priorFindings.title: Bonfire UID fix is unreachable because public option has no picker field
priorFindings.detail: Driver derives any event UID only inside if choice.picker. Bonfire options return offer without picker at both choose and choose_card stages. At choose_card, the command therefore still passes nil; production requires a UID from Purge.purgeCards and returns card_not_purgeable. Seed 3 old evidence reaches exactly this mandatory stage. Current driver cannot resolve that stage and the delivery report overstates its Bonfire picker repair.
priorFindings.requiredFix: Select legal public candidates for Bonfire choose_card explicitly (without submitting UID on earlier offer stage), or share the real UI event selection contract. Verify corrected seed 3 in the planned low-concurrency rerun; keep old failed artifacts.

incrementalReview.result: Unique source blocker resolved; no new source blocker found in narrow delta.
proof: m3-normal-campaign.lua delegates UID resolution to m3-event-card-policy.lua for every chosen event option.

Helper returns nil when picker absent and public stage is not choose_card; at Bonfire choose_card it reads Nodes.view(...).node.event.purgeCards and selects an actual UID. Therefore earlier approach/offer remain UID-free and final offer has legal UID.
Accursed Blacksmith choose_card forge reads public node.upgradeCards; Transmogrifier choose_card change reads public event.purgeCards. Helper never writes Run/Map/card/HP/RNG.
